text: Seat-7, Elsa. You've lit your stall and said nothing while the rest of us trade words like copper and lead. What did you see in the dark before the braziers were lit?

Seat-3, Yoda (3), you talked of shadows and shutters but gave no proof. Tell me plain: did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no. No lantern, no loom—just the braziers' light on the ledger. Who did you vote to banish in the dark?

Seat-7, Elsa (7), you ignored my first question. Now I ask again: What did you see in the dark before the braziers were lit? Silence is copper turned to lead in this bazaar.

Seat-9, Inigo (9), your kettle of words boils but pours nothing. Did you shutter a stall last night? The ledger waits.

Seat-5, Ripley (5), your spice and iron stink of guesswork. Prove your scent or step aside. Who benefits from your accusation?

Speak plain or shut your stall.
